cities.name: Tooele
cities.title: Diesel & Fleet Mechanic in Tooele, Utah
cities.intro: Tooele is where our shop is and where our mobile units start their day. For fleets and heavy equipment based in Tooele County, that means the shortest response time we offer — and the option of shop work or field service, whichever keeps your equipment moving.
items: Shop and field service across Tooele County
Scheduled preventive maintenance by mileage or operating hours
Diesel engine diagnostics and fault-code work
High-pressure hydraulic repair on heavy equipment
Roadside assistance on I-80 and SR-36
Service record and technical report per unit

cities.name: Salt Lake City
cities.title: Mobile Diesel Mechanic in Salt Lake City
cities.intro: We run field and roadside service throughout the Salt Lake area. Our units carry the diagnostic and hydraulic tooling to close most jobs where the equipment sits, so a truck down at a yard, a job site or the shoulder of I-15 does not have to be towed first.
items: Mobile service to yards, job sites and terminals
Electrical diagnostics: alternators, sensors, relays, shorts
Roadside response on I-15, I-80 and I-215
Multi-brand coverage: Cummins, Detroit Diesel, CAT, PACCAR and more
Preliminary quote within one business day

cities.name: West Valley City
cities.title: Fleet & Heavy Equipment Mechanic in West Valley City
cities.intro: West Valley City sits inside our Salt Lake County service radius. We dispatch fully equipped mobile units to warehouses, distribution yards and industrial sites there — the same field service, diagnostics and hydraulic work we run out of Tooele, brought to where the equipment operates.
items: Mobile units dispatched to industrial and distribution sites
Preventive and corrective maintenance for commercial fleets
Diesel and gasoline utility vehicle repair
Hydraulic system diagnostics and leak repair
Emergency response for critical mechanical failures
Documented work with parts and labor detailed
